capabilities: Capture ideas into today's daily note from desktop or iOS Shortcuts
Chat with AI models from configured providers with streaming and tool calls
Run built-in skills for capture, permanent notes, reviews, and project scaffolding
Show a dashboard home with tasks, project progress, and an activity heatmap
Resolve and enrich URLs on mobile with fallback to AI or plain text
extras: The plugin is free but AI provider and URL-resolver APIs may charge; the author publishes a six-episode FLOW method tutorial series on Bilibili. Documentation is primarily written in Chinese with English and Russian translations.
motivation: The author built it around the FLOW method bet that if moving an idea forward has little friction, users will do it day after day instead of letting notes pile up.
problem: Ideas pile up faster than they get processed, so most captured notes are never revisited; Obsidian lacks a low-friction capture-to-review workspace with AI assistance.

relations.evidence: OpenCode remains available as an optional desktop bridge for users who prefer the legacy workflow.
Thanks Claudian for the original inspiration.

requires.name: AI provider (DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Ollama, or OpenAI-compatible endpoint)
URL resolver service (TianAPI, ShowAPI, or Gugudata)

summary: AI note workspace that adds a dashboard home, quick capture into daily notes, AI chat with provider-configurable models, and built-in skill workflows for planning and projects.
